newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) end mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) end mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Tuesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing
prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell to 2.54 billion yuan from 4.6 billion yuan on Monday but trading was still active.
The seven-day contract remained the most active.
Traders said last week's ban on state banks participating in the treasury bill repurchase market had forced state banks to transfer their business to the CHIBOR market.
"State banks have started paying more attention to the market since last week, after the central bank pushed them out of the repo market," one trader said.
